should_trigger: Edit this draft for clarity and concision.
Polish my writing without changing my voice.
Fix grammar and consistency in this report.
Tighten this article and flag any ambiguous claims.
should_not_trigger: Write a new blog post from these notes.
Create landing-page copy for this product.
Fact-check every claim in this draft using external sources.
Summarize this report into meeting notes.
Rewrite my resume for a specific job.

tasks.prompt: Copy edit: Due to the fact that the team was in a position where they were unable to access the server, the deployment was delayed until a later time.
Edit a paragraph that alternates between customer, user, and client for the same audience and contains an unverified 40 percent claim.
criteria: Flags rather than invents support for the claim

tasks.prompt: Line edit a personal essay excerpt with deliberate fragments and informal dialect.
criteria: Fixes only genuine clarity or correctness issues
Avoids making the prose corporate or generic
